taxonomy.certainty: Promises guaranteed, assured, fixed, risk-free or '100%' outcomes, profits or allotment.
taxonomy.unrealistic-return: Returns far above normal market levels: daily/weekly/monthly percentage gains, money doubling, multi-bagger promises.
taxonomy.urgency: Pressure to act immediately: deadlines, 'today only', limited slots, countdowns, 'before it is banned'.
taxonomy.personal-payment: Asks to pay a personal UPI ID, a phone number, an individual's or 'escrow/compliance' bank account or QR instead of an official channel in the investor's own app.
taxonomy.credentials: Asks for OTP, UPI PIN, password, CVV, card number, login ID or other secret codes.
taxonomy.remote-access: Asks to install a screen-sharing or remote-support app, share a screen code, or stay on a video call under watch.
taxonomy.chat-group: Pushes the person into a WhatsApp/Telegram/other group or channel ('VIP group', 'premium channel').
taxonomy.borrowing: Encourages taking a loan, using a credit card, pledging gold or borrowing from others to invest or trade.
taxonomy.withdrawal-fee: Demands a tax, fee, deposit or charge before profits, bonuses or funds can be withdrawn or released.
taxonomy.unverified-app: Pushes an unknown trading/investment app, website platform or APK outside a registered broker's official app.
taxonomy.impersonation: Claims to be, or be approved by, a regulator, exchange, bank, broker, police/CBI/ED/customs or a celebrity; includes false 'SEBI registered/approved' claims.
taxonomy.tips: Unsolicited buy/sell calls, operator or insider tips, 'sure-shot' targets or paid advisory/tips services.
taxonomy.threat: Threatens arrest, legal action, penalty, account block/freeze or disconnection.
taxonomy.suspicious-link: Shortened, lookalike or non-official link, or a link/file to install an app (APK).
taxonomy.fake-ipo: Claims of pre-IPO access, QIB/anchor/HNI/institutional quota, or guaranteed or 'confirmed' IPO allotment.
taxonomy.recovery-offer: Offers to recover money lost to scams, usually for an upfront fee, or poses as a recovery agency/cell.
